title: First group and the Shuffling Hungarians
summary: His early public work was amateur; the first group he formed included Robert Parker and a boy who claimed to be Hungarian, which gave the band its name.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Not my group, I was just with them. I worked with them. That's the first showing that I appeared with in the public. Mm-hmm. I was with them. Sonny Boyd Williams, we worked together at the New York Inn. Well I made appearance in front of people. Nothing professional.
Yeah, this is just amateur stuff.

Yeah. To make a quarter, you know. First group that I formed was Al Miller. With Al Miller. Yeah. Robert Parker. One size. One that recorded Balfootin'. Yeah. And myself. It was hard to go way back. I had another kid with me with a- Swish? No, this was a different thing. This was the very first group that I formed.
